They are known for their large mold size capabilities and cater primarily to the automotive and heavy truck industries, ensuring high mechanical strength and corrosion resistance in their products.We will upload 8gb of corporate data soon. Kadick Integrated Limited is a Nigerian company that offers agency banking, IT solutions, airtime distribution, procurement, and financial services. The company specializes in connecting businesses and individuals to platforms that streamline digital sales and local financial transactions.

eicoh.com EICOH Co., Ltd. (株式会社エイコー) is a Japanese IT and office solutions company founded in 1972 in Osaka by Yamada Goichi, now with dual headquarters in Osaka and Tokyo, 430 employees and annual revenue of 13.5 billion yen. Led by President Sakai Taihei since March 2024, it provides office equipment optimization, digital transformation, cybersecurity, paperless workflow and sales enablement services for major Japanese corporations. The company holds 25 government construction licenses covering civil engineering, telecommunications, electrical and building works. It operates subsidiaries in renewable energy (Eiko Energio with 2.2 MW solar capacity), media and regional services across Kinki, Kanto, Kyushu and Tohoku. Its history spans copier sales in the 1970s, fax boom in the 1980s, system integration in the 1990s and green energy since 2000. The company celebrated 50 years in 2024 and launched a new mission, vision and values under its new president.

vinsonprocess.com Revenue $296.3 Million Vinson Process Systems Company is an American process equipment and engineering firm founded in 1972 in Tulsa, Oklahoma, with over 54 years of experience serving the oil, gas, chemical and petrochemical industries. With approximately 300 to 500 employees across 10 offices in major US energy basins including Houston, Midland, Denver and Williston, it provides separation, heat transfer, compression, pumping and water treatment systems. The company partners with over 50 equipment manufacturers including Emerson, Ariel, Flowserve and Cameron to deliver turnkey process solutions. Its services span process engineering, equipment selection, skid-mounted system integration, commissioning and field service. Family-owned since its founding, it serves upstream, midstream and downstream sectors across North America with modular and custom-designed process packages.

Atlas Healthcare Partners specializes in partnering with health systems and physicians to develop, manage, and invest in Ambulatory Surgery Centers (ASCs). They are recognized as a trusted advisor, providing industry expertise to enhance patient experience and care quality. The company offers a unique partnership model that empowers nonprofit health systems and physicians to control financial growth and care quality.

Marquis Companies is a family-owned provider of senior living and care solutions, offering a range of services including assisted living, memory care, post hospital care, and home health care. Established in 1989, the company focuses on delivering personalized care plans tailored to the unique needs of each resident. Their award-winning facilities are staffed by dedicated professionals who ensure high-quality, person-centered care in a comfortable environment

Safco Dental Supply LLC specializes in providing a wide range of dental supplies, products, and equipment, including restorative and cosmetic dentistry supplies, endodontics, orthodontics, and infection control products. They cater to dental professionals by offering over 20,000 products, expert support, and efficient shopping solutions. The company also provides comprehensive dental equipment services and customized financing solutions to support dental practices. With a focus on reliability and safety, Safco aims to enhance patient care and streamline operations for dental professionals.
Since 1993, Life Line Screening has brought clinical-grade preventive testing to communities across America. More than 11 million people have trusted us with their health.

Raleigh Orthopaedic is a leading provider of comprehensive orthopedic care in Wake County, NC, offering both conservative and surgical treatment options. With over 100 years of experience, the practice specializes in various areas including sports medicine, joint replacement, and physical therapy. They serve a diverse clientele, including patients of all ages, and operate multiple locations for convenient access to care. The team of 27 physicians performs over 9,000 procedures annually, ensuring personalized treatment plans for each patien

Baron & Budd is a prominent plaintiffs law firm specializing in mesothelioma cases, class actions, and drug injury claims. With over four decades of experience, they advocate for victims harmed by asbestos and other toxic substances, providing free consultations and working on a contingency fee basis. Their services extend to various legal areas, including environmental litigation and serious accidents, aiming to protect communities and secure compensation for clients
Shannon Medical Center is a community-owned health system in West Texas, dedicated to providing exceptional healthcare services to residents.
SBH Health System provides nonsectarian, and acute care, and community hospital care services. SBH Health System is based in the Bronx

SACHEM, Inc. is a global leader in high-purity chemical solutions, specializing in the production of precise and pure products for various applications. The company offers a wide range of products including electronic materials, specialty chemicals, and energy materials, catering to clients in Europe, Asia, and America. SACHEM also provides customized manufacturing, R&D support, and consulting services to meet the specific needs of its customers. With advanced laboratories and a strong regional support system, SACHEM is committed to delivering high-quality solutions and fostering innovation

prinsel.com.mx Productos Infantiles Selectos S.A. de C.V. (PRINSEL) is a Mexican children's products company founded in 1960 in Toluca de Lerdo, State of Mexico, with 66 years of experience manufacturing and distributing children's footwear, clothing and accessories. With approximately 200 to 500 employees, it serves the Mexican market through retail stores and distribution networks. Its product range covers shoes, clothing, baby items and school supplies for children from newborns to age 16. The company also operates in real estate and building management through subsidiary structures. Its motto is Quality and Trust for Your Children, reflecting decades of brand recognition among Mexican families. Based in the State of Mexico, it remains one of the oldest and most established children's product companies in the country.

solarium.com.br Solarium Revestimentos is a Brazilian manufacturer and distributor of ceramic tiles, porcelain, mosaics and decorative wall panels based in São Paulo with over 20 years of market presence. Its product range covers porcelain tiles in marble, concrete, wood and natural stone finishes from 30x30 to 120x260 centimeter formats for residential and commercial projects. With approximately 50 to 150 employees and estimated revenue of 20 to 50 million reais, it distributes through builders, retail chains like Leroy Merlin and its own showrooms across Brazil. The company operates its own manufacturing facility with in-house quality control and ABNT certification. Its portfolio includes decorative panels, geometric patterns, tropical designs and minimal collections alongside standard ceramic and porcelain. Key sectors are residential construction, commercial interiors and hospitality projects.

na.org.mk The National Agency for European Educational Programmes and Mobility is a government institution in Skopje, North Macedonia, established in 2006 to administer EU education and mobility programs including Erasmus+, Erasmus Mundus and the European Solidarity Corps. Over 20 years it has managed more than 2,500 projects involving 50,000 plus mobile participants and administering over 200 million euro in EU grants. Its activities cover higher education, vocational training, school education, youth and sport through Erasmus+ Key Actions 1, 2 and 3. The agency partners with over 1,000 organizations including universities, schools, NGOs and companies across 33 Erasmus+ countries. It also operates Eurodesk, eTwinning and Youthpass platforms for youth information and certification. Led by a director and board appointed by the Ministry of Education, it serves as North Macedonia's official Erasmus+ national coordinator.

bllcpas.com Burgess Lowman Lay CPAs is an American accounting firm based in Wilmington, North Carolina, with over 50 years of experience serving small and medium businesses, nonprofits and individuals. With approximately 20 to 30 professionals, it provides tax preparation and planning, bookkeeping, audits, reviews and business advisory services. Its client base includes manufacturing, real estate, healthcare, nonprofit organizations and high-net-worth individuals across southeastern North Carolina. Specialized offerings include employee benefit plan audits, single audits, IRS representation, business valuation and outsourced CFO services. The firm operates under the motto More Than Just Numbers, emphasizing strategic advisory beyond traditional compliance. Founded by its three named partners Burgess, Lowman and Lowman, it has built a deep reputation in the Wilmington business community.

alanmokengineering.com Alan Mok Engineering Pte Ltd is a Singapore-based mechanical and electrical engineering contractor founded in 2000, providing HVAC, plumbing, fire protection, electrical and low voltage systems for commercial, industrial, marine and institutional projects. With 100 to 200 employees and estimated revenue of 10 to 30 million Singapore dollars, it delivers full-cycle M&E services from design through commissioning and maintenance. Its specializations include chillers, ducting, sprinkler systems, electrical distribution, lightning protection and marine HVAC. The company holds BCA accreditation and bizSAFE certification with ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001 standards. Projects span condominiums, office towers, factories, hospitals, schools and shipyards across Singapore. Led by founder Alan Mok, it has built a 26-year track record in Singapore's competitive M&E engineering market.

triad.co.ke Triad Group is a Kenyan digital marketing and technology company founded in 1993 in Nairobi, making it one of the oldest and largest digital agencies in East Africa with 200 plus employees and 500 plus clients. It operates across five divisions: digital marketing, creative and design, technology, strategy and media, with offices in Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda. Its client roster includes major multinational brands like Unilever, Coca-Cola, Safaricom, KCB and Toyota alongside government agencies and NGOs. Services span branding, video production, SEO, social media, software development, AI and machine learning, data analytics and media planning. The company positions itself at the intersection of creativity and technology with a full-service model from strategy to execution. Revenue is estimated in the multi-million dollar range with regional expansion across East Africa.

ninv.com National Investments Company (NIC) is one of Kuwait's leading investment firms, founded in 1987 and listed on Boursa Kuwait as NINV, managing 4.3 billion dollars in assets across four segments: investment, treasury, real estate and asset management. Led by CEO Fahad Abdul Al Mukhaizim, it employs 161 people across its Kuwait City headquarters and Dubai DIFC office. In 2026 it reported net profit of KWD 10.6 million for the first 9 months with AUM reaching KWD 1.4 billion and total return of 545 percent since 2019 versus 122 percent for the Kuwait index. It executed the Trolley General Trading IPO with 15.2x oversubscription and the Ali Alghanim Sons IPO, the largest in Kuwait in over a decade. Recognized by Euromoney as Best Investment Bank in Kuwait for Equity Capital Markets three consecutive years. Its strategy targets becoming a leading regional investment firm by 2029 through international expansion, alternative investments and strategic global partnerships.

municieneguilla.gob.pe Municipalidad Distrital de Cieneguilla is the local government of the Cieneguilla district in Lima Province, Peru, serving approximately 100,000 residents in a growing agricultural and tourism area along the Río Lurín. Led by Mayor Emilio Alberto Chávez Huaringa with 42 employees, it operates a digital services platform including virtual document submission, property tax queries, pet registration and sports facility booking. Key projects include the 2027–2029 Multi-Year Investment Plan, participatory budgeting and an inter-agency initiative to recover the Río Lurín ecosystem. The municipality promotes Cieneguilla as a natural refuge near Lima through a dedicated tourism portal showcasing local gastronomy, agriculture and outdoor activities. Transparency measures include a public accountability portal, public hearings and annual reporting to the Comptroller General. Staff grew by 162 percent as the municipality expanded digital and social inclusion programs.

gruposancristobal.com.mx Grupo San Cristóbal is a Mexican group of companies based in Mexico City, founded by Cristian Montalvo Flores, offering property management, accounting, construction, insurance and legal services across 10 plus business units. With over 250 employees, 500 clients and 2,800 properties under management, it provides full-cycle services for property owners and businesses. Its property management division handles condominium administration, maintenance, security, budgeting and owner meetings. Accounting services include bookkeeping, tax filings, payroll and audits for Mexican businesses. The construction arm delivers new builds, remodeling and preventive maintenance. The group's motto is Your Happiness Is Our Business, and it continues expanding its service portfolio across Mexico.

groupe-alternance.com Groupe Alternance is a French private education group founded in 2008 in Paris, offering work-study (alternance) programs across 5 schools with 10,000 plus students, 300 plus staff and 1,200 plus partner companies. Its model lets students earn a salary while their employer pays for their education, covering Bachelor, BTS and MBA programs in management, marketing, finance, HR, logistics, tourism and sport management. Key schools include ESAM, EFB, ECE, IPAC and the Institut de Management International, with campuses in Paris, Lyon, Marseille, Toulouse, Lille, Bordeaux and Strasbourg. Programs run through apprenticeship and professionalization contracts with companies covering tuition costs. Graduates receive state-recognized diplomas from Bac+2 to Bac+5. Its motto is that training should cost nothing and earn everything, positioning it as a new generation of business schools.

sielke.com Sielke is a German family company founded in 2002 in Hamburg, operating two brands: Sielke Papier for paper, packaging and office supplies, and Sielke Home for stylish home and living products. Headquartered at Dynamowerk 1 in Hamburg-Harburg, it has been serving businesses and consumers for 23 years. Sielke Papier provides a full range from printing and kraft paper to custom packaging solutions with sustainable FSC-certified options. Sielke Home offers decoration, kitchen, bath, wellness and gift products under the motto You Are Home. The company is estimated at 2 to 10 million euro in revenue with a small team of 20 to 50 employees.

imas.es I-Mas Informatica S.L. is a Spanish IT services company founded in 2002 in Sabadell, Barcelona, specializing in custom software development, cloud solutions, ERP implementation, cybersecurity and managed IT services. With 50 to 120 employees and estimated revenue of 3 to 8 million euro, it serves small and medium businesses, industrial companies and public sector clients across Catalonia and Spain. Its technology stack includes SAP, Odoo, Microsoft Dynamics, AWS, Azure, React, Java and Python. Services span web and mobile development, cloud migration, business intelligence, network management and VoIP telephony. The company positions itself as a full-service technology partner for businesses in the Vallès Occidental region and beyond. Its 24-year track record covers manufacturing, retail, healthcare, education and logistics sectors.

humboldt.ca City of Humboldt is a municipality in central Saskatchewan, Canada, founded in 1905 and named after scientist Alexander von Humboldt, with approximately 6,500 residents and a regional catchment of 30,000 people. It is the 13th city of Saskatchewan, located 117 km east of Saskatoon at the heart of the province's Iron Triangle agricultural and potash mining region. Its landmark project is a $40 million wastewater treatment facility completed in March 2026, funded $25 million by federal and provincial ICIP grants and $15 million by the city. Led by Mayor Rob Muench and outgoing City Manager Joe Day who retires in August 2026 after nearly a decade, the city employs 100 to 200 people across police, fire, water, recreation and public works. Major employers include Nutrien and BHP potash mines, Schulte Industries and Bourgault Industries agricultural manufacturers. The city runs a balanced water utility at 103 percent revenue coverage and has increased its debt limit to $20 mill.

resotechlaurentides.com Reso & Tech Laurentides is a Canadian industrial engineering company founded in 2001 in Saint-Jérôme, Quebec, specializing in the design and manufacture of specialized machinery, automation systems and robotic cells for automotive, aerospace, pharmaceutical and food industries. With approximately 150 employees and over 1,500 completed projects exported to more than 20 countries, it offers full-cycle services from concept design through manufacturing, commissioning and maintenance. Its capabilities span PLC and SCADA automation, industrial robotics, machine vision, test systems and custom assembly lines. The company operates from its main facility in Saint-Jérôme with commercial offices in Laval and Toronto. Revenue is estimated at 30 to 50 million dollars. Its automotive clients include major North American manufacturers while its aerospace and pharmaceutical projects demand precision engineering and sterile environments.

darrequipment.com Revenue $304.6 Mil Darreq Equipment is a specialty equipment rental company founded in 2010 in Denver, Colorado, with a second office in Bozeman, Montana, serving the Mountain West region including Colorado, Wyoming and Montana. With 50 to 100 employees and estimated revenue of 10 to 25 million dollars, it provides mobile generators, transformers, chillers, dehumidifiers, compressors, light towers and temporary infrastructure for construction, oil and gas, mining, healthcare and data center clients. It distinguishes itself from mass-market rental companies like United Rentals by focusing on specialized high-demand equipment for complex projects. The company operates its own delivery fleet with 24/7 emergency response capability. Key sectors include large-scale construction, energy projects, disaster recovery and data center cooling. Its niche approach avoids direct competition with national rental giants while serving demanding industrial clients in the Mountain West.

megatrans.com.ar Megatrans S.A. is an Argentine road freight and logistics company founded in 1991 in Lanús, Buenos Aires, with 35 years of experience in general, heavy and dangerous goods transportation across Argentina and Mercosur. With over 200 employees and a fleet of 150 plus trucks, it operates regional terminals in Rosario, Córdoba, Neuquén and Mendoza with GPS-tracked vehicles. Its specialized services include ADR-certified dangerous goods transport for chemical, pharmaceutical and oil and gas industries alongside food and automotive logistics. The company holds CNRT and RUTA Seguro 837 certifications and provides full-cycle logistics including warehousing, customs clearance and insurance. International routes cover Brazil, Chile, Uruguay, Paraguay and Bolivia. Major clients include YPF, BASF, Arcor, Toyota Argentina, Carrefour and Techint.

unitedpharmacy.sa United Pharmaceuticals Company is Saudi Arabia's third largest pharmacy chain, founded in 1990 in Jeddah by Sheikh Dr. Mohammed Al Yassin, with 450 plus branches across 80 cities and over 1,100 employees in 8 countries. It holds a 10 percent market share and targets 15 percent by 2027 through aggressive expansion, including the SAR 100 million acquisition of Kunooz Pharmacies in February 2026 and plans to open 100 new branches this year. Led by CEO Khalid Yassin since January 2024, it was awarded Great Place to Work in Saudi Arabia in 2024 and 2025. Its mobile app has 656K installs with a 4.71 star rating and offers cash on delivery, Tamara installment plans and insurance prescription dispensing. Strategic MoUs with Sudair Pharma and PPI Company aim to expand access to innovative medicines. The company competes with Nahdi (1,207 stores) and Al Dawaa (954 stores) but grows fastest among the top three.

clancysystems.com Clancy Systems International is an American parking technology company founded in 1978 in Englewood, Colorado, with over 10,000 parking systems installed in more than 500 cities across the United States and Canada. With approximately 130 employees and estimated revenue of 25 to 50 million dollars, it provides pay stations, parking software, license plate recognition and smart city solutions. Its ParkEngine cloud platform handles real-time parking management, enforcement, permits and revenue analytics. The company offers solar-powered stations, ADA-compliant units and EV charging integration alongside mobile payment options. It is one of the oldest and largest parking technology providers in North America with 48 years of continuous operation. Services span installation, maintenance, 24/7 support and consulting for municipal and private parking operators.

orennia.com Orennia is a Canadian energy intelligence platform founded in 2021 in Calgary, providing data analytics for solar, wind, battery storage, hydrogen, carbon capture, transmission and crypto mining sectors. With 116 employees and 1,000 plus platform users, it has raised 35 million dollars from General Catalyst and other investors, generating estimated revenue of 18.7 million dollars with 30 percent annual growth. Led by founder and CEO Brooke Coleman, its platform combines project databases, market intelligence, interconnection queue tracking and AI-powered predictive analytics. Clients include utilities, renewable developers, private equity, hedge funds and banks across North America. Its unique Interconnection Queue Tracker covers every major grid operator in the US and Canada. The company is based in Calgary with a second office in Toronto and competes with Enverus, Wood Mackenzie and Bloomberg NEF.

esri-southafrica.com sri South Africa is the exclusive distributor of Esri's ArcGIS geospatial platform in southern Africa, founded in 1989 in Midrand with 206 employees across 5 offices and over 2,000 clients. Led by Managing Director Patrick McKivergan, it serves government, utilities, mining and banking sectors with major projects like the City of Cape Town CityMap Viewer and ESKOM asset management. Its Esri South Africa College offers an NQF Level 6 Diploma in GISc&T and is the only Esri accredited learning center in the region. The company holds B-BBEE Level 1 status and runs free GIS training for unemployed youth. It participates in the Map Africa Initiative with Microsoft and Space42 to map all 54 African countries. Revenue is estimated at 23.2 million dollars with government contracts including a R34 million deal with DFFE.
